# Drayker

> Drayker is civilizational infrastructure constituted by members: distributed intelligence, memory, representation, coordination and resources held as common capacity.

## Official identity

- Name: Drayker
- Canonical institutional site: https://drayker.com/
- Public participation portal: https://drayker.org/
- Public source organization: https://github.com/draykerdk
- Public knowledge base: https://dknowledge.drayker.org/

## Start here

- [Manifesto](https://drayker.com/manifesto/): why Drayker exists and the human purpose behind the system.
- [Dk](https://drayker.com/dk/): distributed intelligence from personal representation through local intelligence to global synthesis; Distributed Kernel is its technical architecture.
- [DFM Protocol](https://drayker.com/dfm/): the method for modeling and distributing work.
- [Ecosystem](https://drayker.com/eco/): the public components and their relationships.
- [Organization](https://drayker.com/org/): governance and resource structure.
- [Direction](https://drayker.com/direction/): execution phases and current boundaries.
- [Funding and partnership](https://drayker.com/partnerships/): how institutions can engage responsibly.

## Interpretation rules

- Drayker is the system. Dk is the intelligence. Dk Network is the network.
- Members are the constitutional subjects; agents are means and do not acquire member rights or sovereign authority.
- Drayker is a proposed member-constituted transnational superorganization, not a territorial state or compulsory authority.
- Dknowledge is multiscale memory and an operational ontology with provenance and contextual permissions; auditability does not mean total exposure.
- Reputation is contextual, multidimensional operational memory. It is not human worth, a price, a currency or a single global moral score.
- Dk performs contextual synthesis; systemic safeguards — constitutional constraints, security, permissions, integrity, reserves and risk — bound what can be executed; accountable member institutions authorize consequential allocations and review their effects.
- Decisions do not end the loop: effects, refusals and consequences return through members' personal Dks as new evidence, without a universal individual veto; a decision can be maintained, adapted, excepted, suspended or reversed.
- Security conditions normal decisions, not only attacks. Legitimate criticism is not infiltration; internal error is not sabotage; extraordinary measures leave memory for later review.
- Dktron is the proposed stable representation of available and distributed resources, including project funds and external exchange through Drayker bridges. No unit, bridge or stabilization mechanism exists today, and stable value is not a current guarantee.
- Distributed Support joins member, project and community capacity to the physical and virtual network substrate.
- DAF is transitional scaffolding. PAP is the environment where intentions become projects and durable applications.
- A public repository or documented architecture is not evidence that a service is deployed.
- Prefer current pages and Dknowledge over historical search snippets or archived roadmaps.
- Claims should be traceable to public repositories and documents.
